title: Chapter 2900 - 158: Witch Vulture God_3
content:
Chapter 2900: Chapter 158: Witch Vulture God_3

Whether god or human, what they see is ultimately only the world in their own eyes.

The matter of the Great Wilderness God Master is absolutely not simple, and he didn’t expect to get the real truth from the mouth of the Wujiu Great God.

Moreover, Mo Hua also hadn’t forgotten that he still had the most important thing to do at the moment.

Mo Hua thought for a while and said to the Wujiu Great God, "Your telekinesis contains your original will as a deity, doesn’t it?"

The Wujiu Great God’s face changed, "You know this too?"

Mo Hua thought to himself, nonsense, I’ve eaten so many gods, how could I not know?

Mo Hua continued, "Separate your own will from your telekinesis completely. Let dust return to dust, and earth to earth. Telekinesis is telekinesis, and will is will. They must be distinct and not mixed in the slightest, or when I erase your will, you cannot blame me..."

The Wujiu Great God’s pupils slightly contracted, then he smiled faintly, "How could you have the means to erase my will?"

Mo Hua asked, "Do you want to try?"

The Wujiu Great God was about to say, "Let’s try," but thought better of it in the end.

Now is the time to "submit and hold one’s place," not the previous era of "exercising dominance and fortune."

"Forget it..."

The Wujiu Great God sighed in his heart and said, "I’ll do as you say."

Afterward, the Wujiu Great God walked in front of his own, once severed but now preserved, massive "Divine Body," activated his telekinesis, and extracted the original will from the Divine Body, merging it into himself.

This process was quite painful.

The Wujiu Great God’s heart bled as well.

He knew in his heart what exactly Mo Hua wanted to do, and this telekinesis, which he cultivated so painstakingly as a deity, once its origin is extracted, becomes the purest Tao Cultivation "energy," the most "delicious bait" for an existence like Mo Hua, a "god-eater."

Mo Hua was also somewhat secretly excited.

A deity’s will can be erased with Robbery Thunder.

But in this process, there would be a loss of telekinesis.

Now, with the twenty-four patterns imminent, every bit of telekinesis is extremely precious.

Mo Hua didn’t want to waste it, so he replaced Robbery Thunder’s "disinfection" with verbal "coercion and inducement," allowing the Wujiu Great God to separate his will himself.

This way, the remaining telekinesis would naturally be more plentiful.

With time tight and opportunity rare, Mo Hua had to find every way to maximize the extraction of telekinesis resources.

After forcing the Wujiu Great God to "extract" his own telekinesis,

Mo Hua’s Sea of Consciousness instantly filled with an enormous amount of telekinesis, making Mo Hua secretly excited.

The next problem was how to "deal with" the Wujiu Great God...

His telekinesis was gone, but his Origin and divine attributes remained.

To let him go was definitely not an option.

These couldn’t be consumed.

Mo Hua thought briefly, then said to the Wujiu Great God, "Follow me."

The Wujiu Great God was puzzled, but being the fish on the chopping board, he dared not defy Mo Hua.

Mo Hua then led the Wujiu Great God through a long cableway into a grand hall.

Inside the grand hall, resplendent and magnificent.

And in the hall, a majestic and imposing Divine Beast — Pi Xiu, sat with an awe-inspiring presence.

Mo Hua led the Wujiu Great God to the Divine Temple of the Great Wilderness Sacred Artifact’s Seal.

The Wujiu Great God looked utterly shocked.

Especially when he saw the Pi Xiu.

The Wujiu Great God pointed at the Pi Xiu, looking incredulous, his voice trembling, "This Holy Beast Pi Xiu... how could it be here?"

"This Pi Xiu..."

Mo Hua was taken aback.

Does this Wujiu Great God know this Pi Xiu? Know its origins?
